blocks.en: If these conditions do not hold, a problem is said to be \emph{ill-posed}. Of course, the meaning of the term \emph{continuity with respect to the data} has to be made more precise by a choice of norms in the context of each problem considered.
blocks.zh: 如果这些条件不成立, 就称该问题是\emph{不适定的}. 当然, 对于所考察的每个具体问题, 都必须通过选取范数, 使\emph{关于数据的连续性}这一说法的含义更加精确.

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.en: In the course of this book we classify most of the problems we encounter as either well-posed or ill-posed, but the reader should avoid the assumption that well-posed problems are always "better" or more "physically realistic" than ill-posed problems. As we saw in the problem of buckling of a beam mentioned above, there are times when the conditions of a well-posed problem (uniqueness in this case) are physically unrealistic. The importance of ill-posedness in nature was stressed long ago by Maxwell~\cite{Max}:
blocks.zh: 在本书中, 我们会将遇到的大多数问题划分为适定问题或不适定问题, 但读者不应认为, 适定问题总比不适定问题"更好"或"更符合物理实际". 正如前面提到的梁的屈曲问题所显示的, 有时适定问题的条件 (在这个例子中是唯一性) 并不符合物理实际. Maxwell 很早就强调了自然界中不适定性的重要性~\cite{Max}:

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.en: For example, the rock loosed by frost and balanced on a singular point of the mountain-side, the little spark which kindles the great forest, the little word which sets the world afighting, the little scruple which prevents a man from doing his will, the little spore which blights all the potatoes, the little gemmule which makes us philosophers or idiots. Every existence above a certain rank has its singular points: the higher the rank, the more of them. At these points, influences whose physical magnitude is too small to be taken account of by a finite being may produce results of the greatest importance. All great results produced by human endeavour depend on taking advantage of these singular states when they occur.
blocks.zh: 例如, 被冰霜松动而平衡在山坡某个奇点上的岩石, 点燃大片森林的一点火星, 使世界陷入争斗的一句话, 阻止一个人随心所欲的一丝顾忌, 使所有马铃薯枯萎的一点孢子, 使我们成为哲学家或白痴的一点芽球. 凡等级达到某种程度以上的存在, 都有其奇点: 等级越高, 奇点就越多. 在这些点上, 某些影响的物理量值小到有限的存在者无法将其计入, 却可能产生极其重要的结果. 人类努力所产生的一切伟大成果, 都有赖于在这些奇异状态出现时加以利用.

blocks.en: Representations
blocks.zh: 表示公式
blocks.label: subsec:representations

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.en: There is one way of proving existence of a solution to a problem that is more satisfactory than all others: writing the solution explicitly. In addition to the aesthetic advantages provided by a representation for a solution there are many practical advantages. One can compute, graph, observe, estimate, manipulate and modify the solution by using the formula. We examine below some representations for solutions that are often useful in the study of PDEs.
blocks.zh: 证明一个问题存在解, 有一种比其他所有方法都更令人满意的方式: 将解显式地写出来. 除了美感上的优点之外, 解的表示公式还有许多实际优点. 利用公式, 可以对解进行计算, 作图, 观察, 估计, 运算和修改. 下面考察一些在偏微分方程研究中经常有用的解的表示公式.

blocks.en: Cauchy's integral formula is the most important result in the theory of complex variables. It provides a representation for analytic functions in terms of its values at distant points. Note that this representation is rarely used to actually compute the values of an analytic function; rather it is used to deduce a variety of theoretical results.
blocks.zh: Cauchy 积分公式是复变函数理论中最重要的结果. 它利用解析函数在远处各点的值给出该函数的一种表示. 注意, 这种表示很少用于实际计算解析函数的值; 相反, 它被用于推导各种理论结果.

blocks.en: Estimation
blocks.zh: 估计
blocks.label: subsec:estimation

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.en: When we speak of an \emph{estimate} for a solution we refer to a relation that gives an indication of the solution's size or character. Most often these are inequalities involving norms of the solution. We distinguish between the following two types of estimate. An \emph{a posteriori} estimate depends on knowledge of the existence of a solution. This knowledge is usually obtained through some sort of construction or explicit representation. An \emph{a priori} estimate is one that is conditional on the existence of the solution; i.e., a result of the form, "If a solution of the problem exists, then it satisfies ..." We present here an example of each type of estimate.
blocks.zh: 说到解的一个\emph{估计}, 我们指的是一种能够表明解的大小或性质的关系. 这些关系大多是涉及解的范数的不等式. 我们区分以下两类估计. \emph{后验估计}依赖于对解的存在性的了解. 这种了解通常通过某种构造或显式表示获得. \emph{先验估计}则是以解的存在为条件的估计; 即形如"如果问题的解存在, 那么它满足 ..."的结果. 这里分别给出这两类估计的一个例子.

blocks.en: Gronwall's inequality and energy estimates
blocks.zh: Gronwall 不等式与能量估计

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.en: In this section we derive an a priori estimate for solutions of ODEs that is related to the energy estimates for PDEs that we examine in later chapters. The uniqueness theorem~\ref{thm:ode-uniqueness} is an immediate consequence of this result. To derive our estimate we need a fundamental inequality called Gronwall's inequality.
blocks.zh: 本节推导常微分方程解的一个先验估计, 它与后面各章将考察的偏微分方程能量估计有关. 唯一性结果 Theorem~\ref{thm:ode-uniqueness} 是这一结果的直接推论. 为了推导所需的估计, 我们需要一个称为 Gronwall 不等式的基本不等式.

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.label: lem:gronwall

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points
visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.en: The proof of this is left as an exercise.
blocks.zh: 这一结果的证明留作习题.

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.en:
Let $\bm{F}:\mathbb{R}\times\mathbb{R}^n\to\mathbb{R}^n$ satisfy the hypotheses of Theorem~\ref{thm:ode-existence}, in particular let it be uniformly Lipschitz in its second variable with Lipschitz constant $\gamma$ (cf. \eqref{eq:uniform-lipschitz-bound}). Let $\bm{y}_1$ and $\bm{y}_2$ be solutions of \eqref{eq:ode-initial-value-dynamics} on the interval $[t_0,T]$; i.e.,
\[
\bm{y}_i'(t)=\bm{F}(t,\bm{y}_i(t))
\]
for $i=1,2$ and $t\in[t_0,T]$. Then
\begin{equation}\label{eq:ode-energy-estimate}
|\bm{y}_1(t)-\bm{y}_2(t)|^2\leq|\bm{y}_1(t_0)-\bm{y}_2(t_0)|^2e^{2\gamma(t-t_0)}.
\end{equation}
blocks.zh:
设 $\bm{F}:\mathbb{R}\times\mathbb{R}^n\to\mathbb{R}^n$ 满足 Theorem~\ref{thm:ode-existence} 的假设, 特别地, 它关于第二个变量一致 Lipschitz 连续, Lipschitz 常数为 $\gamma$ (参见 \eqref{eq:uniform-lipschitz-bound}). 设 $\bm{y}_1$ 和 $\bm{y}_2$ 是 \eqref{eq:ode-initial-value-dynamics} 在区间 $[t_0,T]$ 上的解; 即对于 $i=1,2$ 和 $t\in[t_0,T]$, 有
\[
\bm{y}_i'(t)=\bm{F}(t,\bm{y}_i(t))
\]
那么
\begin{equation}\label{eq:ode-energy-estimate}
|\bm{y}_1(t)-\bm{y}_2(t)|^2\leq|\bm{y}_1(t_0)-\bm{y}_2(t_0)|^2e^{2\gamma(t-t_0)}.
\end{equation}
blocks.label: lem:ode-energy-estimate
blocks.title_zh: 常微分方程的能量估计

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.en:
We begin by using the differential equation, the Cauchy-Schwarz inequality and the Lipschitz condition to derive the following inequality.
\[
\begin{aligned}
&|\bm{y}_1(t)-\bm{y}_2(t)|^2\\
&=|\bm{y}_1(t_0)-\bm{y}_2(t_0)|^2+\int_{t_0}^t\dfrac{\mathrm{d}}{\mathrm{d}s}|\bm{y}_1(s)-\bm{y}_2(s)|^2\,\mathrm{d}s\\
&=|\bm{y}_1(t_0)-\bm{y}_2(t_0)|^2\\
&\quad+\int_{t_0}^t2(\bm{y}_1(s)-\bm{y}_2(s))\cdot(\bm{F}(s,\bm{y}_1(s))-\bm{F}(s,\bm{y}_2(s)))\,\mathrm{d}s\\
&\leq|\bm{y}_1(t_0)-\bm{y}_2(t_0)|^2+\int_{t_0}^t2|\bm{y}_1(s)-\bm{y}_2(s)|\,|\bm{F}(s,\bm{y}_1(s))-\bm{F}(s,\bm{y}_2(s))|\,\mathrm{d}s\\
&\leq|\bm{y}_1(t_0)-\bm{y}_2(t_0)|^2+\int_{t_0}^t2\gamma|\bm{y}_1(s)-\bm{y}_2(s)|^2\,\mathrm{d}s.
\end{aligned}
\]
Now \eqref{eq:ode-energy-estimate} follows directly from Gronwall's inequality.
blocks.zh:
首先利用微分方程, Cauchy-Schwarz 不等式和 Lipschitz 条件, 推导下列不等式.
\[
\begin{aligned}
&|\bm{y}_1(t)-\bm{y}_2(t)|^2\\
&=|\bm{y}_1(t_0)-\bm{y}_2(t_0)|^2+\int_{t_0}^t\dfrac{\mathrm{d}}{\mathrm{d}s}|\bm{y}_1(s)-\bm{y}_2(s)|^2\,\mathrm{d}s\\
&=|\bm{y}_1(t_0)-\bm{y}_2(t_0)|^2\\
&\quad+\int_{t_0}^t2(\bm{y}_1(s)-\bm{y}_2(s))\cdot(\bm{F}(s,\bm{y}_1(s))-\bm{F}(s,\bm{y}_2(s)))\,\mathrm{d}s\\
&\leq|\bm{y}_1(t_0)-\bm{y}_2(t_0)|^2+\int_{t_0}^t2|\bm{y}_1(s)-\bm{y}_2(s)|\,|\bm{F}(s,\bm{y}_1(s))-\bm{F}(s,\bm{y}_2(s))|\,\mathrm{d}s\\
&\leq|\bm{y}_1(t_0)-\bm{y}_2(t_0)|^2+\int_{t_0}^t2\gamma|\bm{y}_1(s)-\bm{y}_2(s)|^2\,\mathrm{d}s.
\end{aligned}
\]
现在, 由 Gronwall 不等式立即得到 \eqref{eq:ode-energy-estimate}.

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.en: Note we can derive the uniqueness result for ODEs (Theorem~\ref{thm:ode-uniqueness}) by simply setting $\bm{y}_1(t_0)=\bm{y}_2(t_0)$ and using \eqref{eq:ode-energy-estimate}. Also observe that these results are indeed obtained \emph{a priori}: nothing we did depended on the existence of a solution, only on the equations that a solution would satisfy if it \emph{did} exist.
blocks.zh: 注意, 只需令 $\bm{y}_1(t_0)=\bm{y}_2(t_0)$ 并利用 \eqref{eq:ode-energy-estimate}, 就能得到常微分方程的唯一性结果 (Theorem~\ref{thm:ode-uniqueness}). 还要注意, 这些结果确实是\emph{先验地}得到的: 我们所做的一切都不依赖于解的存在, 而只依赖于解如果\emph{确实}存在就应当满足的方程.

blocks.en: Smoothness
blocks.zh: 光滑性
blocks.label: subsec:smoothness

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.en:
One of the most important modern techniques for proving the existence of a solution to a partial differential equation is the following process.
\begin{enumerate}
\item Convert the original PDE into a "weak" form that might conceivably have very rough solutions.
\item Show that the weak problem has a solution.
\item Show that the solution of the weak equation actually has more smoothness than one would have at first expected.
\item Show that a "smooth" solution of the weak problem is a solution of the original problem.
\end{enumerate}
blocks.zh:
证明偏微分方程存在解的最重要的现代技巧之一, 是下面这一过程.
\begin{enumerate}
\item 将原来的偏微分方程转化为一种"弱"形式, 这种形式或许可以有很粗糙的解.
\item 证明弱问题存在解.
\item 证明弱方程的解实际上具有比最初预期更多的光滑性.
\item 证明弱问题的一个"光滑"解就是原问题的解.
\end{enumerate}

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.en: We give a preview of parts one, two, and four of this process in Section~\ref{subsec:laplace-equation} below, but in this section let us consider precursors of the methods for part three: showing smoothness.
blocks.zh: 下文的 Section~\ref{subsec:laplace-equation} 将预先展示这一过程的第一, 第二和第四部分; 而在本节, 我们来考察第三部分, 即证明光滑性的方法的一些先导结果.

blocks.en: The following is an example of a "bootstrap" proof of regularity in which we use the fact that $\bm{y}\in C^0$ to show that $\bm{y}\in C^1$, etc. Note that this result can be used to prove the regularity portion of Theorem~\ref{thm:ode-existence} (which asserted the existence of a $C^1$ solution).
blocks.zh: 下面给出一个正则性的"自举"证明的例子: 利用 $\bm{y}\in C^0$ 这一事实证明 $\bm{y}\in C^1$, 再依次类推. 注意, 这一结果可以用来证明 Theorem~\ref{thm:ode-existence} 中关于正则性的部分 (该定理断言存在一个 $C^1$ 解).

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.label: thm:ode-bootstrap-regularity

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.en:
Since $\bm{F}(s,\bm{y}(s))$ is continuous, we can use the Fundamental Theorem of Calculus to deduce that the right-hand side of \eqref{eq:sturm-liouville-kernel-eigenproblem} is continuously differentiable, so the left-hand side must be as well, and
\begin{equation}\label{eq:ode-bootstrap-differential-equation}
\bm{y}'(t)=\bm{F}(t,\bm{y}(t)).
\end{equation}
Thus, $\bm{y}\in C^1(\mathbb{R})$. If $\bm{F}$ is in $C^1$, we can repeat this process by noting that the right-hand side of \eqref{eq:ode-bootstrap-differential-equation} is differentiable (so the left-hand side is as well) and
\[
\bm{y}''(t)=\bm{F}'_{\bm{y}}(t,\bm{y}(t))\cdot\bm{y}'(t)+\bm{F}_t(t,\bm{y}(t)),
\]
so $\bm{y}\in C^2(\mathbb{R})$. This can be repeated as long as we can take further continuous derivatives of $\bm{F}$. We conclude that, in general, $\bm{y}$ has one order of differentiability more than $\bm{F}$.
blocks.zh:
由于 $\bm{F}(s,\bm{y}(s))$ 连续, 可利用微积分基本定理推出 \eqref{eq:sturm-liouville-kernel-eigenproblem} 的右端连续可微, 因而左端也必须连续可微, 并且
\begin{equation}\label{eq:ode-bootstrap-differential-equation}
\bm{y}'(t)=\bm{F}(t,\bm{y}(t)).
\end{equation}
于是 $\bm{y}\in C^1(\mathbb{R})$. 如果 $\bm{F}$ 属于 $C^1$, 就可以重复这一过程: 注意到 \eqref{eq:ode-bootstrap-differential-equation} 的右端可微 (从而左端也可微), 并且
\[
\bm{y}''(t)=\bm{F}'_{\bm{y}}(t,\bm{y}(t))\cdot\bm{y}'(t)+\bm{F}_t(t,\bm{y}(t)),
\]
所以 $\bm{y}\in C^2(\mathbb{R})$. 只要还能继续对 $\bm{F}$ 求连续导数, 就可以重复上述过程. 因此, 一般而言, $\bm{y}$ 的可微阶数比 $\bm{F}$ 多一阶.

blocks.en:
Let $\bm{y}_k$ be the sequence defined by \eqref{eq:picard-iteration}. Show that
\[
|\bm{y}_{k+1}(t)-\bm{y}_k(t)|\leq\gamma(t-t_0)\max_{\tau\in[t_0,t]}|\bm{y}_k(\tau)-\bm{y}_{k-1}(\tau)|.
\]
Use this to show that the sequence converges uniformly for $t_0\leq t\leq T$ for any $T<t_0+1/\gamma$.
blocks.zh:
设 $\bm{y}_k$ 为 \eqref{eq:picard-iteration} 定义的序列. 证明
\[
|\bm{y}_{k+1}(t)-\bm{y}_k(t)|\leq\gamma(t-t_0)\max_{\tau\in[t_0,t]}|\bm{y}_k(\tau)-\bm{y}_{k-1}(\tau)|.
\]
利用这一结果证明, 对任意 $T<t_0+1/\gamma$, 该序列在 $t_0\leq t\leq T$ 上一致收敛.
blocks.label: ex:picard-uniform-convergence

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.en:
Use the implicit function theorem to determine when the equation
\[
x^2+y^2+z^2=1
\]
defines implicitly a function $\hat{x}(y,z)$. Give a geometric interpretation of this result.
blocks.zh:
利用隐函数定理, 确定在什么情况下方程
\[
x^2+y^2+z^2=1
\]
隐式定义函数 $\hat{x}(y,z)$. 给出这一结果的几何解释.

blocks.en: Elementary Partial Differential Equations
blocks.zh: 初等偏微分方程
blocks.label: sec:elementary-pdes

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.en: In the last section we discussed the basic types of mathematical questions that are considered throughout the rest of this book, and we looked at how those questions had been answered by two subdisciplines of PDEs: ODEs and complex variables. We now look at how these questions are often approached in elementary courses on partial differential equations. To do this, we consider three basic PDEs (Laplace's equation, the heat equation and the wave equation). Although we sometimes use an analytical approach to investigate their character, our basic technique is the explicit calculation of solutions. At this point we are not terribly concerned with either rigor or generality but rather with foreshadowing material to come; all of the methods and observations presented here are generalized later on.
blocks.zh: 上一节讨论了本书其余部分将始终考察的几类基本数学问题, 并考察了偏微分方程的两个分支, 即常微分方程和复变函数理论, 是如何回答这些问题的. 现在来看, 初等偏微分方程课程通常如何处理这些问题. 为此, 我们考察三个基本偏微分方程 (Laplace 方程, 热方程和波动方程). 尽管有时也采用分析方法研究它们的性质, 但我们的基本技巧是显式地计算解. 此时我们并不十分关注严密性或一般性, 而着重预示后面的内容; 这里介绍的所有方法和观察, 都将在后面加以推广.
